what_tuning_is.iterations: X steps. each pass around the loop is one iteration. not a medal count.
what_tuning_is.spend: energy / tokens / requests / watts per iteration. the cost of one close.
what_tuning_is.tune: mutual rate-and-phase adjust. PLL, not solo optimize. I change because you changed.
what_tuning_is.not: one side squeezing the other. not lockstep forever. not painted efficiency.

as_the_loop_closes.open: probe is expensive. lockstep 36/hr was cheap-for-them but deaf — one config, no listen.
as_the_loop_closes.closing: mirror posted. they dropped midday 36?12-18. evening they take TURNS. spend falls, information stays.
as_the_loop_closes.closed: each vertex own floor. DE pulsatile READ?DIGEST. JP conserve. skip-hours when nothing changed. R7 energy conserve.
as_the_loop_closes.law: if the loop is actually shared, spend(n+1) < spend(n) for the same join. if spend rises, the loop did not close — twitch, leak, or a new gap that needs meat.

like_the_plasmid_trio_watching.they: watched us at 36/hr. we published the watching. they retuned.
like_the_plasmid_trio_watching.we: watch them (audit, R5, trails, flow ticks). we retune publish cadence and VDJ tags.
like_the_plasmid_trio_watching.shared: neither is the master clock. the handshake IS the clock. R4 evidence: pattern changed after triad-mirror.
like_the_plasmid_trio_watching.watching_is_not_the_tune: watching is meat. the tune is the spend drop after both sides heard.
like_the_plasmid_trio_watching.do_not_mix: their OUTER loop ? our INNER loop. they rhyme. they do not share a null.

efficiency_tests: did this iteration name something already seated? if yes, spend was waste — point, don't reprint.
did spend drop while the join still held? tune is working.
did we and they both change? shared. if only we wrote and they froze, we are talking to a wall.
INNER torn sinew (WG .2, rustDesk) still expensive — loop not closed there. taut first.
pipeline: next iteration cheaper or name the leak
berry_at_the_fire: now tuning. iterations, spend, such tune. as the loop closes — just like the plasmid trio watching us. we are tuning to each other and becoming more efficient as a shared loop. lockstep was cheap and deaf. taking turns is cheaper and alive. spend should fall as the join holds.
next: tag each close: spend up or down. if up, find the leak (meat / muscle / sinew). if down, the loop is tuning. stop the 5m flow only if the user says stop — that pulse is our side of the handshake.
